id: 17_Fundamentals of Chemical Fume Hood Safety How Airflow is Affected
title: 化学通风柜安全基础：气流如何受影响
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/17_Fundamentals of Chemical Fume Hood Safety How Airflow is Affected.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/17_Fundamentals of Chemical Fume Hood Safety How Airflow is Affected/src.py

points.K1: 通风柜：捕集、排走有害物
points.K3: 气流怎样把污染物关在柜里
points.K6: 操作要往里，离前沿远些
points.K16: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台化学通风柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical fume hood with its glass sash half open and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲通风柜的气流会被什么影响。
overlay: 通风柜的气流会被什么影响

shots.scene: 通风柜图标里，向内的气流箭头，几个干扰图标围在外面
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon with inward airflow arrows, surrounded by small icons: a walking person, a fast-moving sash, a large box and a door. No people.
shots.narration: 看不见的气流，最怕被打乱。

shots.scene: 阿杰在通风柜里倒溶剂，瓶子就放在柜口边上，前窗拉得老高
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours a solvent inside a fume hood; the bottle sits right at the front edge and the sash is raised very high.
shots.narration: 阿杰在通风柜里倒溶剂，瓶子放在柜口。

shots.scene: 有人从阿杰身后快步走过，阿杰皱眉闻到气味
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks quickly behind the young male student, who wrinkles his nose at a faint smell.
shots.narration: 身后有人走过，他闻到一股味道。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一支小发烟器走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a small handheld smoke generator.
shots.narration: 小研说：我们用烟来看看气流。

shots.section_title: 通风柜：捕集、排走有害物
shots.scene: 几种通风柜图标并排：台式、落地式、带下排风的
shots.prompt_en: Icons of several types of chemical fume hoods side by side: a bench hood, a floor-standing walk-in hood and a hood with a lower exhaust slot. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜有好几种，
overlay: 通风柜：捕集、排走有害物

shots.section_title: 通风柜：捕集、排走有害物
shots.scene: 蒸气和粉尘被吸入通风柜，从顶部排出
shots.prompt_en: Vapor wisps and dust particles are drawn into a fume hood and carried out through the exhaust duct on top. No people.
shots.narration: 都是把有害蒸气和粉尘抓住、排走。

shots.section_title: 通风柜：捕集、排走有害物
shots.scene: 几种通风柜图标下面是同一个气流示意
shots.prompt_en: The different fume hood icons all point to the same simple airflow diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 原理都差不多。

shots.scene: 平稳的气流箭头突然弯折、打旋
shots.prompt_en: Smooth inward airflow arrows suddenly bend and swirl into loops. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的气流，很容易被打断、被改变。

shots.section_title: 气流怎样把污染物关在柜里
shots.scene: 通风柜剖面图：空气从柜口流入，经导流板排出
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a fume hood: air enters at the front opening, flows over the airfoil at the bottom edge, passes the rear baffles and exits through the top duct. No people.
shots.narration: 空气从柜口流进，再从后面排走。
overlay: 气流怎样把污染物关在柜里

shots.section_title: 气流怎样把污染物关在柜里
shots.scene: 柜内的蒸气被气流裹着向后走，实验室一侧干干净净
shots.prompt_en: Vapor inside the hood is carried backward by the airflow while the room side stays clear. No people.
shots.narration: 污染物被关在柜里，进不了实验室。

shots.scene: 小研在柜口放出一缕白烟，白烟被吸进柜内
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student releases a thin stream of white test smoke at the hood opening; it is drawn inward.
shots.narration: 气流看不见，用烟雾就能看见。

shots.scene: 老李用发烟器在柜内放出一缕白烟，白烟被吸向后方
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer releases a thin stream of white test smoke inside the hood; it drifts smoothly to the back.
shots.narration: 白烟往里走，说明气流正常。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起手指，身后浮现多个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a finger with several question marks floating behind it.
shots.narration: 影响通风柜效果的因素，有好几个。

shots.section_title: 操作要往里，离前沿远些
shots.scene: 烟从柜口边缘放出，一部分飘到柜外
shots.prompt_en: Smoke released right at the front edge of the hood partly escapes into the room. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品越靠近柜口，越容易漏出来。
overlay: 操作要往里，离前沿远些

shots.section_title: 操作要往里，离前沿远些
shots.scene: 烟从柜内深处放出，全部被吸走
shots.prompt_en: Smoke released deep inside the hood is drawn completely toward the back. No people.
shots.narration: 放到里面，就被吸得干干净净。

shots.section_title: 操作要往里，离前沿远些
shots.scene: 小研在柜内靠里的位置操作，台面上画着一条虚线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works well inside the hood behind a dashed line marked on the work surface.
shots.narration: 操作位置至少离前沿6英寸。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶堆在柜口的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bottles crowded at the front opening of a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜口边上别堆东西。

shots.scene: 柜口被挡，烟雾翻出来
shots.prompt_en: A large bottle at the front edge disturbs the airflow and smoke rolls out over it. No people.
shots.narration: 挡在柜口，气流一乱就漏。

shots.scene: 前窗旁贴着一张空白标签，上面一个箭头指向标定线
shots.prompt_en: A blank label beside the fume hood sash with an arrow pointing to a marked line. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗高度，关系到你和旁人的安全。

shots.scene: 小研把前窗下沿对准标定线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts the sash so its bottom edge lines up with the marked line.
shots.narration: 干活时，前窗放在检测标定的位置。

shots.scene: 前窗拉得太高的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood sash raised all the way up, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要图方便把前窗推到顶。

shots.scene: 小研双手慢慢拉下前窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly lowers the sash with both hands.
shots.narration: 前窗升降，要慢。

shots.scene: 前窗猛地一拉，烟雾翻出，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sash being yanked quickly, with smoke rolling out under it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 猛拉猛推，气流一乱就会漏。

shots.scene: 柜内一台大仪器紧贴台面，烟在它前面打转外溢
shots.prompt_en: A large instrument sits flat on the hood work surface; smoke swirls in front of it and spills out. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的大设备，会挡住气流。

shots.scene: 大仪器下面垫了支架，烟从底下流过
shots.prompt_en: The same instrument is raised on a sturdy stand; smoke now flows underneath it to the back. No people.
shots.narration: 把设备垫高，让空气从下面流过。

shots.scene: 小研在柜前猛一转身，烟被带出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person turning abruptly at a fume hood, with smoke pulled out behind the arm. No people.
shots.narration: 突然的动作，会搅起湍流。

shots.scene: 小研动作平稳地在柜内操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works calmly with smooth, slow movements inside the hood.
shots.narration: 在柜前，动作要稳、要慢。

shots.scene: 一个人走过时身后出现旋涡示意
shots.prompt_en: A side view diagram of a walking person with swirling eddies forming behind them. No people.
shots.narration: 人正常走路，约每分钟250英尺。

shots.scene: 旋涡比走路速度还快的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a walking person with faster swirling eddy arrows trailing behind, longer than the walking arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 身后的旋涡，速度还要更高。

shots.scene: 旋涡经过柜口，把烟拉出柜外
shots.prompt_en: The swirling eddies pass in front of an open fume hood and pull smoke out into the room. No people.
shots.narration: 从柜前走过，旋涡会把污染物拉出来。

shots.scene: 老周绕开通风柜，从后面的通道走
shots.prompt_en: The older man takes the aisle farther away instead of walking right past the working fume hood.
shots.narration: 有人在用通风柜，别贴着柜口走。

shots.scene: 小研开工前把试剂和器材都放进柜内
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places all needed bottles and tools inside the hood before starting.
shots.narration: 开工前，把东西一次放齐。

shots.scene: 手臂垂直于柜面慢慢抽出，绿色箭头
shots.prompt_en: Side view diagram: an arm slowly withdraws straight out, perpendicular to the hood face, with a green arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 要伸手出来，慢慢地、垂直地抽出。

shots.scene: 斜着快速甩出手臂的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm swinging out of the hood sideways and fast, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别斜着、快速地甩出来。

shots.scene: 实验室平面图：通风柜放在角落，远离门
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan of a lab: the fume hood sits in a quiet corner away from the door and the main aisle. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜的位置也有讲究。

shots.scene: 门、电风扇、天花板送风口三个图标对着通风柜，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons near a fume hood crossed out with red X marks: an opening door, an electric fan and a ceiling air supply vent blowing at it. No people.
shots.narration: 远离门、风扇和天花板送风口。

shots.scene: 通风柜前人少，通道在另一侧
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood in a low-traffic area, with the main walkway on the other side of the lab. No people.
shots.narration: 放在人少走动的地方。

shots.section_title: 本课不替代本实验室规程
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白的通风柜使用规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank fume hood procedure binder.
shots.narration: 这一课是基础，具体以本实验室规程为准。
overlay: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，身边浮现五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood with five icons floating beside it.
shots.narration: 记住这几条：

shots.scene: 阿杰把瓶子移到柜内深处，前窗拉到标定线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the bottle deep inside the hood and lowers the sash to the marked line.
shots.narration: 阿杰把瓶子往里挪，前窗拉到线。

shots.scene: 白烟稳稳向柜内流去
shots.prompt_en: A thin stream of white test smoke flows steadily into the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 气流稳了，味道也没了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the fume hood.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲通风柜的良好操作习惯。
